column6: Zereda's clause 'near Succoth' was read from 2CH 4:17, whose word is Zeredathah of the Jordan valley (zeredah-2), which already says it; Zereda itself is folded into Zeredah of Ephraim
The word of 2CH 4:17 that names Zeredathah of the Jordan valley is Strong's H6868, now on this record
